scope: Offline English synthetic WAV ASR prefix comparison on local Qwen MPS. Excludes native microphone/system audio, diarization, translation, IPC, and UI.
question: Can a final decode reuse a previous preview when only 640 ms of exact digital silence was appended?
decision: Rejected final reuse: one incomplete English finance prefix changed last-word output after zero padding. Final recognition continues to decode every accepted PCM sample unless exact same samples were already previewed.
timing_limit: One prefix/padded pair per fixture length, prefix always first. Not a speed benchmark or general ASR quality estimate.
